escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark studio at night with thin haze, dramatic and high-contrast): Nexa stands with her body centred at about 50 % of the frame width, framed from the chest up, her head at about 40 % of the frame height, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm f/1.8. MOMENT: caught at the instant she lifts her gaze up and to her frame-right, toward the air above and beside her shoulder, with a quietly impressed, curious expression, lips slightly parted, as if something just lit up in front of her eyes; head almost frontal, chin lifted a little, only her eyes and a slight turn go up-right. Her hands are out of frame or relaxed and low; she does not touch or point at anything. The air ABOVE and to the FRAME-RIGHT of her shoulder, from about 62 % to 100 % of the frame width and from the top of the frame down to her shoulder line, is EMPTY dark studio space with thin haze — no object, no screen, no panel, no light fixture. A strong glow comes from that empty air, its source out of view: a warm AMBER light (#FFB703) rakes across the frame-right side of her face, hair and shoulder, mixed with a cool azure-white fill, and catches as small highlights in her eyes; the haze in that zone glows. The lower frame-right corner, near the lens, is also empty dark space. A cool azure rim from behind separates her from the dark; far behind, a few large cold round bokeh. The LEFT 35% of the frame is calm deep dark studio with faint haze and soft cool bokeh. Enormous contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this horizontal photo is shown small, about 440 pixels wide, inside a dropdown panel; so ONE clear subject reads instantly at that size, sits in the RIGHT half, and the left part is calm continuation of the same scene.
